blocks.x: Cloud, Edge & Platform Engineering — platform economics, golden paths, and the edge where latency becomes revenue.

Platforms are economics wearing an engineering uniform: golden paths convert engineering months into days, FinOps turns cloud spend into unit economics, and at the edge latency is literally revenue. These are the positions we defend with numbers.
Written from migration factories, platform builds and edge estates we operate every day.
